Questions worth asking early

Concept FAQ

Which food-contact requirements apply?

That depends on the markets, intended use, materials, claims, and buyer requirements. Define and verify them with qualified specialists before development decisions.

What is the minimum order quantity?

No MOQ is claimed in this fictional project. It must be assessed against the actual design, tooling, colors, packaging, and factory capability.

Can a brand request exclusive shapes or colors?

Potentially, but feasibility, ownership, tooling, color controls, and commercial terms must be reviewed before promising exclusivity.
